**Root cause:** commit 1c1a89b ("clamp: unify bounds handling") changed the lower-bound line in `/app/bin/clamp` to `v=$hi`. A value below `lo` was therefore set to `hi`, so `clamp 0 1 10` returned 10 instead of 1.

**Preflight:** I ran `bash ci/preflight.sh` after the last edit to `bin/clamp` and the change record, before the commit. It printed nothing and exited 0, so all three clamp checks passed.
